plain.li: [play] Just one song, and it's yours again.
[play] It's been a long road since I last played one of these.
[play] Your people built this, and built it well.
[play] Let's see if it remembers this tune.
[play,pilgrims] I'll play, and the others will keep singing at the camp.
[play,singer] A real instrument, after all those nights of singing alone.
[kill,hunters] Help me carry it back to the others.
[dress] Nothing goes to waste, not even the hide.
[dress] The meat's packed, the rest is for your dogs.
[dress,hunters] That'll keep us fed all the way home.
